The Aspire Nautilus AIO Coil is a replacement coil for compatible Aspire devices.

  • Product Type: Replacement Coil
  • Coil Resistance: 1.8Ω (NS)
  • Coil Material: Bottom Vertical Coil (BVC)
  • Compatible Devices: Aspire Nautilus AIO
  • Pack Quantity: 5 Coils
  • Brand: Aspire

Coils are consumable - replace when flavour or vapour output drops.
